method.poster: Native 1072 x 1920 poster and opening identity comparison inspected separately.
method.scope: Sampled visual inspection against the supplied performance and character concept; no continuous playback or audio verdict.

findings: Riko remains recognizable through the pink cropped sweater, choker, curled blonde-and-pink hair, ribbon, denim shorts, and sneakers.
Cross-steps, forward reaches, torso turn, knee lift, and overhead head-wrap correspond to the reference sequence at inspected times.
The inspected native frames show complete shoes, hair, and hands with clear image borders. The separate technical report records a clear 180-frame border scan.
Palms are proportionate in the inspected frames; fine finger contours remain simplified or merged in some gestures.
Leg bends and gesture heights are stylized. Exact foot contact, sliding, and between-sample continuity are not established.
The native output keeps substantial empty space above the character; downstream framing is an explicit editorial operation.
publication_scope: An additional active-choreography transfer study with its native output and review limitations.
limits: Sampled inspection cannot certify every transition or continuous timing.
Fine fingers, exact floor contact, and universal transfer reliability are not claimed.
A new stochastic generation requires fresh review.
